Name: Shared Recipes
Author: jpslatt
Description:
This mod allows farmers and farmhands  to share their crafting and cooking recipes with each other. It synchronizes the recipes between multiple farmers in a multiplayer game, ensuring that all players have access to the same recipes.The mod provides a menu integration for configuring the sharing options and displays notifications when recipes are shared or received.


You can configure crafting/cooking individually if you want to disable/enable the categories.

The recipes will be synced at the start of each day or you can manually sync using the keybinds. Default is Shift + S + R
